currentParagraphText: “Thanks for the heads-up,” Jake said before the god did an exaggerated bow, still looking Jake in the eyes. “With that, I say my goodbyes...”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: He teleported away, and right after, a voice echoed in Jake’s mind through their bond as Chosen and Patron.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I think you’ll be surprised, but stocking up here is still a good idea,” the god nodded. “Anyway, have fun.
